Name: The Shack - The Ultimate Artisan Good Icons with BAGI
Author: UsoliaNaviento
Description:
[b]It's the first time i do pixel art and the first time i do a mod.[/b]
[b]
[/b]I use more than 400 mods on my own save files, and i wanted to have some... consistency with all the artisan goods. (And with so much more items lol)

So, first thing first : I do my own base for some Artisan Goods product, using vanilla product.

I start with [b]Wines[/b], [b]Juices[/b], [b]Jellies[/b], [b]Pickles[/b] and [b]Honeys[/b]. 

[b][u]Installation :
[/u][/b]- You will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]Better Artisan Good Icons
[/url]- Inst﻿all only the part for the other mods that you have!

[b]Update :[/b]
[i]03 / 03 / 23
[/i]     - 1.1 Adding compatibility for SVE and Forage of Ferngill !
[i]09 / 03 / 23[/i]
     -1.2 Adding Ancient Crops, PPJA, Quaint Living. I add the Wild Flower honey too, i forget this poor one, my bad!
[i]08 / 10 / 23[/i]
     - 1.4 New sprites for Honey and Jelly. Little change for Wines and Juice. All mod have is own color stickers on the product. A lot of new mods combability.
| Adventurer's Guild Expanded, Atelier Wildflour Mega Pack, Beetle Crops,  Bonster's Oddi-Trees and Rare Crops, Circle of Thorns, Deng Deng Monogatari, Faerie Garden, Huckleberry Season(Raffadax Fix), Lumisteria Flowers and Crops, Lunna Astray, Magical Crops, Raffadax, Ridgeside Village, Trinkets, Winter Crops, | 

[b]Compatility :
[/b]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12102]Adventurer's Guild Expanded[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4472]Ancient Crops
[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16189]Atelier Wildflour Mega Pack﻿[/url]

[/url]-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17231] Faerie Garden[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15812]Huckleberry Season - Raffadax Comtability version[/url]

[b]To Do List :﻿[/b]
NOTHING RIGHT NOW! Loool I did ALL the mods i have (i think...?) But i can do pack for mods that i don't use right now or that i could have forgot!

Like i said, it's my first mod. Don't be shy (but don't be harsh lol) about idea, opinion, or advices about this mods! Have a nice day everyone!
